title: 해양경찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Meetings)
(1) Meetings of the Committee shall be classified into regular meetings and extraordinary meetings.
(2) Regular meetings shall be convened by the chairperson twice each month, except in special circumstances.
(3) The chairperson may convene an extraordinary meeting when necessary; three or more members, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, or the Commissioner of the Korea Coast Guard may request the chairperson to convene an extraordinary meeting.
(4) Where a request to convene an extraordinary meeting is made under paragraph (3), the chairperson shall convene the meeting unless there is a special reason not to do so.
